title: Mice in Sticky Trap (17258577795)
author: NY State IPM Program at Cornell University from New York, USA
description: These two mice were found in a sticky trap in a school kitchen. The one to the right was still alive upon inspection, but the one in the back had obviously been there for awhile, providing a food source for other pests. Looking to evict mice?
